chunks.title: Account Access & Password Reset Runbook — Self-service password reset
chunks.text:
## Self-service password reset

Customers can reset passwords from the login page using the "Forgot password"
link. The reset email arrives within 2 minutes and the link is valid for 60
minutes. This resolves the majority of access issues and requires no support
involvement.

chunks.title: Technical Troubleshooting Guide — API errors
chunks.text:
## API errors

- 401 errors: check that the API key is active and sent as a Bearer token.
- 429 errors: the account hit its rate limit; retry with exponential backoff.
- 5xx errors: check the status page first; if degraded, notify customers of
  the incident rather than troubleshooting client-side.

chunks.title: Refund Policy — Refund window
chunks.text:
## Refund window

Customers may request a prorated refund within 30 days of the charge date.
Annual subscriptions cancelled mid-term are refunded prorated on unused whole
months, minus a 10% administrative fee.

chunks.title: Pricing & Plans — Discounts
chunks.text:
## Discounts

Annual billing saves 2 months (roughly 17%). Registered nonprofits receive
40% off any plan. Volume discounts start at 50 seats.

chunks.title: Refund Policy — Processing
chunks.text:
## Processing

All refunds must be logged in the CRM with the reason code REFUND-DUP,
REFUND-WINDOW, or REFUND-GOODWILL. Customers receive a confirmation email when
the refund is issued.

chunks.title: Account Access & Password Reset Runbook — Two-factor authentication issues
chunks.text:
## Two-factor authentication issues

Customers who lost their 2FA device must submit a signed identity
verification form. Support must never disable 2FA based on email requests
alone. Escalate all 2FA removals to the security team.

- Starter: $29/user/month, core features, email support.
- Growth: $79/user/month, advanced analytics, priority email support.

Growth plans include a 14-day free trial. Trials do not require a credit
card. Trial extensions of up to 14 additional days can be granted by support
one time per account as goodwill.

chunks.title: Refund Policy — Duplicate charges
chunks.text:
## Duplicate charges

If a customer is charged twice for the same subscription period, the duplicate
charge is fully refundable. Refunds under $500 are processed automatically by
the billing system and appear on the customer's original payment method within
5-7 business days. Refunds of $500 or more require manager approval before
processing.
